change: Group previously flat application state by lifecycle

review.decision: Use opt-in grouped routing with an offline, journaled and reversible transition.
review.notes: Legacy routing is the default. Both layouts use the same contents and inode for each moved store. Known external path contracts remain stable. The CLI blocks during a partial transition. Tests write only an isolated HOME, so disk state, sockets and queues in the running installation are untouched. Independent review found a shared DSH registration path that must remain flat. Exercise the shipped plugin and the production Go registration reader together before resubmitting. The remaining independent findings cover admission against a loaded manager, an interrupted atomic write, misleading transition preview, and housekeeping following the active store. Delta review requires an installed macOS LaunchAgent to be persistently disabled as well as unloaded, and flatten must use directory-only cleanup against late conflicting paths. Systemd evidence must be complete and the CLI alias follows the same admission.

cases.description: Grouped storage replaces flat routing reversibly and leaves other paths stable
cases.setup: Disposable home with pane state, a receipt, an event counter, a backup, a stable upload and unknown data.
cases.action: Inspect both layouts and move a sample in both directions, including a new receipt in the grouped layout.
cases.expected: Each owned source moves by inode to its declared group and back. No duplicate or regenerated receipt. Preview and legacy path lookup are side effect free. Stable and unknown entries are untouched.

cases.description: Interrupted and conflicting layout changes protect both sides
cases.setup: Disposable home with a durable transition record and a subset already moved, or an occupied destination, replaced source, or symlink.
cases.action: Read layout readiness, continue from the durable record, and exercise identity or destination conflict.
cases.expected: A partial transition gates normal CLI access. The original direction resumes only with exact identity and a unique location. Conflict preserves both sides; completion is durable and idempotent.

cases.description: CLI gates partial layout changes and reads events after relocation
cases.setup: Disposable HOME with real Go event storage and a simulated writer appearing after preparation.
cases.action: Call the production CLI entry for layout inspection, a normal command and the Codex entry. Resume the transition in the fixture and append another ordinary event.
cases.expected: Inspection remains available, entry points that can write are gated while pending, and the event journal and sequence advance in the canonical group without creating a flat event log.

cases.description: Grouped storage opens the actual DSH plugin registration at the stable input boundary
cases.setup: Grouped synthetic HOME, the embedded DSH bridge, fake tmux epoch and hook executable, and isolated DSH session discovery.
cases.action: Register a real plugin attachment, read it through the Go attachment store with synthetic process facts, then check ordinary CLI readiness.
cases.expected: One attachment is visible on the existing terminal-clients path, and registering it does not create an unexpected flat copy of a grouped store or gate normal commands.

cases.description: Background jobs and compatible processes hold storage admission
cases.setup: Disposable home, process and service-manager fixtures with a loaded launchd job or a restarting systemd job and no PID, plus a held shared CLI lease.
cases.action: Probe migration readiness, confirm normal CLI entry gates under the exclusive lease, and exercise both lease directions.
cases.expected: A loaded/restarting job or an unverifiable manager blocks the move. Shared leases coexist and stay held through the command. Migration requires exclusive admission before any move, while inspection remains available.

cases.description: Rollback preserves crash residue from an interrupted atomic writer
cases.setup: Grouped isolated home with authoritative usage data, an exact private staging-file shape, and separately an unknown or linked entry.
cases.action: Inspect, interrupt and resume rollback around archival, then group again.
cases.expected: Authoritative data retains its identity. Valid residue stays private and recoverable outside active storage across retry. Unknown, unsafe or unexpected entries block before further changes.

cases.description: Transition inspection verifies both physical locations
cases.setup: Pending isolated transition with one item already moved and, separately, two copies of another item.
cases.action: Inspect through doctor with the actual pending journal, then compare against the resume decision.
cases.expected: Inspection reports moved and pending stores and explicitly rejects the same conflict as resume, with both copies unchanged.

cases.description: Housekeeping follows the active HQ feed
cases.setup: Grouped isolated home with a known retired feed file, an active cadence marker, and an independent flat path.
cases.action: Check doctor inventory and run normal housekeeping.
cases.expected: Existing retirement policy sees and removes only the named retired file from the active store without deleting the cadence marker or flat copy.

cases.description: Offline migration requires persistent disable for installed LaunchAgents
cases.setup: Synthetic service descriptors and launchctl replies for a missing GUI domain, an enabled or disabled job and an absent standard install.
cases.action: Check the production LaunchAgent admission logic with no process running, then compare both domains and known installed service files.
cases.expected: Unloaded and installed needs persistent disable proof. Absent installation allows an unloaded job; unknown, enabled or conflicting proof stops before migration.

cases.description: Rollback cleanup does not unlink objects that appear after verification
cases.setup: A grouped fixture with a durable rollback journal. After the transition verifies, a known group is replaced by a file or a symlink, or an unrelated entry is created.
cases.action: Call the actual cleanup boundary, then compare paths and the journal after it refuses.
cases.expected: Only fixed empty group directories can be removed. Conflicting files, links and unknown data survive and the journal remains.

cases.description: Offline alias and systemd require complete admission evidence
cases.setup: Pending transition fixture, plus systemd fixture replies with one missing or duplicate required property.
cases.action: Inspect pending layout through dr, confirm its migration flags are exempt from shared admission, and check invalid manager replies.
cases.expected: Doctor and dr remain available with the same behavior. Missing, malformed or duplicate properties cannot establish quiescence.
